schema_version: 1
contract: authored_task_definition
task_types:
  1: frontend_preview
  2: fullstack_page
  3: cli_programming
  4: api_endpoint
  5: debug_fix
  6: refactor_quality
  7: git_cli
  8: sql_query
  9: quiz_theory
  10: practice_task_milestone
  11: test
  12: ordering
  13: classification
capabilities:
  execution_modes: [BROWSER_PREVIEW, TERMINAL_RUN, HTTP_API, NO_RUN]
  evaluation_modes: [AUTO, MANUAL, HYBRID]
  ui_modes: [PREVIEW, TERMINAL, REPORT, QUIZ]
  submission_modes: [SNAPSHOT, ANSWER_PAYLOAD]
  booleans: [requires_sandbox, exposes_preview, exposes_terminal, supports_live_validation]
learning_targets:
  kinds: [concept, capability]
  identity: [type, key, optional version]
  rules: [ordered, unique per task, at most 100, opaque to ms-go-course]
  runtime_projection: GET /internal/task/get-internal-task/{taskID}
  ownership: course stores authored references; student owns evidence and mastery; knowledge graph semantics are not interpreted here
coding_tasks:
  require: [lesson_id, translations, code_structure_type_id, code_structure, nonnegative order]
  tests: forbidden
  allowed_errors_count: normalized to 0
  contract_formats: [legacy code_structure, ValidationContractV1]
assessment_tasks:
  purpose: [knowledge_check, diagnostic]
  default_purpose: knowledge_check
  diagnostic_discovery: {schema: course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1, route: GET /internal/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/{courseID}, active_only: true, allowed_types: [11, 12, 13], evaluation_mode: AUTO, invalid_mode: validation_error, max_tasks: 100}
  storage: [task_test, task_test_i18n, task_test_group, task_test_group_i18n, task_test_variant, task_test_variant_i18n]
  kinds:
    test: {question_kind: single_choice, code_structure_type: TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC}
    ordering: {question_kind: ordering, code_structure_type: TEST_ORDERING_BASIC}
    classification: {question_kind: classification, code_structure_type: TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC}
  common_rules: [at least one question, unique positive question order, localized non-empty question title, 2 to 50 variants, unique positive variant order, allowed_errors_count is nonnegative and less than question count]
  single_choice: [at most 5 variants, exactly one correct variant, no ordering or group fields]
  ordering: [every variant has a unique correct_order from 1 through variant count, is_correct is false, no group fields]
  classification: [2 to 20 localized groups with unique positive order, every variant resolves one group, every group is used, no correct_order, is_correct is false]
  normalization: assessment code structure is server-owned and compose config is cleared
state_rules:
  - task type cannot change while the task is active
  - deactivating a task is forbidden while its parent lesson is active
  - sandbox tasks require a task-level or lesson-level compose config
  - php.core live validation may be advertised only when the versioned contract exposes php.core in live or both mode
  - task deletion is a hard delete through the repository
sources: [internal/domain/task_enums.go, internal/domain/task_learning_target.go, internal/domain/task_capabilities.go, internal/domain/task_contract_validation.go, internal/domain/task_test_model.go, internal/usecase/task]
